name: Loading {VAL}
description: This weapon must be reloaded after expending the magazine. Mechs can reload with Stabilize and some systems.

name: MK.{VAL}
description: This weapon has been upgraded from its base version dealing either more damage having other effects ect.

name: Deadly {VAL}
description: When rolling a crit add {VAL}d4 of bonus damage.

name: Pilot Scale Weapon
description: This weapon is sized for pilots and only deals half damage to mechs but gains +1 Accuracy anything size 1 or larger.

name: Anti-Mech Pilot Weapon
description: This weapon is sized for pilots however it was made to be used against mechs. it gains +1 inaccuracy against any target 1/2 sized target. This weapons also requires the use of power armour.

name: Power armour
description: A stronger version of any other armour in the same class. Power armour gives you the ability to equip and use heavy weaponry due to the weight and power requirements of those weapons.

name: Concealable weapon
description: A weapon that is small enough or has a function to be concealed while in the open.

name: Light Pilot Weapon
description: This weapon can be used as a quick action to fire once or twice as a full action.
